channel.title: Deadly 60
channel.desc: Wildlife guru Steve Backshall is in Australia, searching for animals to add to his Deadly 60 list. Out in the forest, Steve has to have his wits about him when he comes face to face with a huge lace monitor lizard. Australian schoolchildren are taught to respect the continent's deadliest arachnid, the redback spider. Hidden deep in a barn, Steve has an encounter with a redback that has the crew holding their breath.
